findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_vacation_rentals, get_listing_details, find_direct_booking · Private data: refine_search, contact_host, find_direct_booking · Public sink: contact_host, get_property.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_vacation_rentals, get_listing_details, find_direct_booking · Private data: refine_search, contact_host, find_direct_booking · Public sink: contact_host, get_property

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_vacation_rentals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
